name: deck-qa
title_zh: Marp 幻灯片交稿前先过一遍溢出、缺图
tagline_zh: 导出前总担心文字溢出、图片失踪？它逐页查溢出、缺图、密度、排版和结构，发现问题直接动手修，不用自己翻几十页。
tagline_en: Worried about text overflow or broken images before export? It scans every slide for overflow, missing images.
desc_en: Check a Marp deck for overflow, missing images, density, typography, and structure, and fix what it finds. Use after writing or editing slides, before an export, or when the user says QA, check, review, lint, overflow, "does it fit", or "clean up the deck".
why_zh: 不只是报错，而是定位后直接改文件；按溢出、缺图、密度、排版、结构五类逐页扫，修完再查一轮，直到干净。
why_en: It doesn't just report—it edits the source directly. Scans per slide across five categories, applies fixes, then re-checks until.
limit_zh: 只认 Marp 的 Markdown 源文件，不碰 PPTX/PDF；修图只处理缺失引用，不重绘或压缩图片。
limit_en: Only works on Marp Markdown source; not for PPTX/PDF. Fixes missing image refs but doesn't redraw or compress. Complex custom CSS may cause false.
title_en: Marp deck pre-export checker that fixes overflow, missing.
